## Lantern Loop

### TL;DR

Light the lantern, look around, and decide the next step. The loop repeats until the path is clear.

### When To Use It

When the route is unknown and each step reveals the next. See [[Harbor Method]] for the planned version.

### When Not To Use It

When the route is known. Plain walking is cheaper than lighting a lantern at every step.

### Drawbacks and Failure Modes

A lantern burns oil. Long loops cost more than they find.
